finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker-controlled log message containing shell metacharacters
finding.assumptions: The log message is user-controlled or influenced by external input.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the syslog call on line 1. syslog is a standard logging API that writes messages to the system logger; it does not invoke a shell or execute commands. Therefore there is no path from the log message to an OS command execution, and the reported CWE-117 (OS Command Injection) does not apply.
